function.name: search_academic_papers
function.description: Searches Semantic Scholar API for academic papers using keyword or boolean expressions with metadata filters. Returns ranked papers with composite impact scores. Use this as the primary discovery tool.

query.description: Search query string or boolean logic expression. Examples: 'GraphRAG knowledge graph retrieval', '(entity alignment) AND (GNN OR graph neural network)'

yearFrom.description: Filter to papers published from this year onward (inclusive). Example: 2021

yearTo.description: Filter to papers published up to this year (inclusive). Example: 2026

fieldsOfStudy.description: Comma-separated fields to filter by. Valid values: 'Computer Science', 'Medicine', 'Biology', 'Physics', 'Mathematics', 'Economics'. Example: 'Computer Science'

minCitations.description: Minimum citation count threshold. Use to filter for established, impactful papers. Example: 10

limit.description: Maximum number of papers to return. Default: 20. Max recommended: 50.

function.name: traverse_citation_graph
function.description: Traverses the bidirectional citation graph of a specific paper to discover foundational references (backward) or recent papers that cite it (forward). Essential for finding highly influential works that may not appear in keyword searches.

paperId.description: Semantic Scholar Paper ID, DOI, or ArXiv ID. Example: '649def34f8be52c8b66281af98ae884c09aef38d' or 'arXiv:2404.16130' or '10.18653/v1/2024.acl-long.812'

direction.description: Direction of traversal: 'citations' finds papers that CITE this paper (downstream/recent), 'references' finds papers that this paper CITES (upstream/foundational), 'recommendations' finds semantically related papers.

influentialOnly.description: If true, only return papers flagged as 'influential' citations by Semantic Scholar. Recommended: true for focused research.

limit.description: Maximum number of related papers to return. Default: 15.

function.name: get_paper_snippets
function.description: Retrieves exact full-text passages (~480 tokens each) from a specific paper using the Semantic Scholar Open Research Corpus (S2ORC). Use this to extract precise evidence for fact-scoring and in-text citation.

paperId.description: Semantic Scholar Paper ID for the target paper.

query.description: The specific sub-question or evidence query to search within the paper. Be specific. Example: 'What F1 score did the model achieve on HotpotQA?' or 'How does the entity alignment loss function work?'

maxSnippets.description: Maximum number of passages to retrieve. Default: 5.

function.name: get_paper_metadata
function.description: Retrieves complete metadata for a specific paper including abstract, authors, venue, citation counts, and open access PDF link. Use this to verify paper details before citing.

paperId.description: Semantic Scholar Paper ID, DOI, or ArXiv ID.
